product_brief: Crypto-agile Cryptographic Next Generation (CNG) provider for Microsoft Windows enabling post-quantum security and compliance.
pqc_support: Yes — Supports NIST FIPS204 MLDSA, FIPS205 SLHDSA, XMSS, LMS, hybrid combinations, and country-specific standards.
pqc_capability_description: The provider enables seamless integration of customized algorithms into Windows, including NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, XMSS, LMS), hybrid classical/PQC combinations, and country-specific standards (MySEAL, KpqC, NGCC). It supports certified implementations (Common Criteria EAL, FIPS140 CMVP) and hardware integrations (smartcards, USB tokens, HSMs, TEEs).
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, XMSS, LMS, Hybrid combinations of classical and post-quantum algorithms
architecture_type: CNG Provider for Microsoft Windows; integrates with HSMs, TEEs, smartcards, and USB tokens
fips_validated: Supports certified implementations under FIPS140 CMVP; partners with PQShield for FIPS 140-3-certified modules
pqc_roadmap_details: Launched March 2026; supports NIST FIPS204/205, XMSS, LMS, and country-specific standards (Malaysia, South Korea, China)
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Supports Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNG) integration
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Collaborates with PQShield and Feitian Technologies to integrate cryptographic modules
